glamsterdam_security.highlight: ChainSecurity found EIP-8037/8038 repricing allows previously-invalid txs to exploit contracts: gas refund recovery post-revert enables balance updates without ETH transfer
13 major DeFi projects identified as vulnerable; responsible disclosure ongoing; some unresponsive via bug bounty channels; search was not exhaustive
Key broken assumptions: gasleft() can now increase mid-call, OOG detection patterns bypassable, 1/64 retained gas now larger under higher costs
Three response tiers identified: (1) on-schedule mainnet if mitigated in time, (2) delayed mainnet same spec, (3) Glamsterdam spec changes — all contingent on full impact analysis

fork_status_and_schedule.highlight: Hoodi hard fork canceled indefinitely; no new date set; EthPandaOps + client teams represent ~73% of Hoodi stake, rollback deemed feasible
Mainnet date implicitly on hold; December 2026 fork now very unlikely; 2027 expected
Blog post to go out immediately listing pre-Glamsterdam client versions; updated as new rollback releases ship; all clients encouraged to cut new releases

First post-DevCon devnet will be merged hegota-devnet-0 (EL+CL); FOCIL/frames interaction to be discussed in-person at DevCon
max_fee PR (EIPs/pull/12414) to be merged into bogota-devnet-2 after call if no objections raised
